name: Cable-transition bay interface
summary: Marks the electrical transition between the assigned overhead and cable circuit sections.
description: Marks the electrical transition between the assigned overhead and cable circuit sections. A bay circuit arrangement groups the switching, measuring and protection interfaces associated with a specific network circuit. A line bay, transformer bay and reactor bay share some devices but connect different kinds of primary equipment.

In a switchyard single-line drawing, the bay arrangement helps the reader follow the circuit from its bus connection to the external line, transformer or compensation equipment and identify the measurement boundaries along the path. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Overhead-line circuit” at the input and “Cable circuit interface” at the output. Termination and sheath details are separate drawings.
